# opentls.library API headers

The public headers of opentls.library, API version 1, from
DalsinAI/openamigatls main (commit e7c0e2d, 19 October 2026), unchanged.
MIT licensed and free, Copyright (c) 2026 AmigaChrome Team (`LICENSE`).
`src/httpget.c` is built against them for https://; the library itself is
opened at run time, never linked.
